faqHeader.title: What happens after I submit the form?
faqHeader.lead: Here's how we process your inquiry from the first minute.

faqs.question: 1. Immediate confirmation and technical review
faqs.answer: We review the tariff classification, specifications, and requested volume. If more technical detail is needed, Kattya will contact you directly by WhatsApp or call.

faqs.question: 2. Preliminary sourcing or shipping quote
faqs.answer: We check with our offices in China and partner carriers to get the most competitive, up-to-date market rates for the season.

faqs.question: 3. Proposal and shipping plan presentation
faqs.answer: We present a detailed quote with an open cost structure, estimated manufacturing and transit timelines, and control milestones.
